codeReview.summary: The fix commit fully addresses the prior blocking routing failure from both react-vite-setup and react-embed-integration by registering `/dashboard/` alongside `/dashboard`, constraining SPA index serving to exact dashboard entry paths, and updating unauthenticated dashboard route checks to normalize trailing slashes. Static asset and `/dashboard-legacy` behavior are preserved.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The fullstack-worker skill procedure is rigid for mixed-scope work: it requires frontend test-first and Playwright/tsc/vite verification even when a fullstack-assigned fix is backend-only. The worker reasonably executed backend-focused tests only and marked followedProcedure=true, indicating the skill guidance should document a backend-only exception path.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/fullstack-worker/SKILL.md ('Write Tests First — Both Layers' and frontend verification steps) vs worker-transcripts.jsonl skeleton for session 212e3c93-aeab-4ce8-b493-6ffc23b5fddd (Go tests/vet/build only; no frontend test commands).

sharedStateObservations.observation: The service start command in services.yaml does not capture a known recovery path when compose dependency health blocks openclawssy startup. The worker had to use `docker compose up -d --no-deps openclawssy` due an unhealthy dependency.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/services.yaml openclawssy.start uses `docker compose up -d openclawssy`; handoff for session 212e3c93-aeab-4ce8-b493-6ffc23b5fddd records failure from unhealthy `openclawssy-becomussy-1` and successful workaround with `--no-deps`.
